amount.not_positive: The amount must be more than 0.
amount.fraction_not_allowed: This currency has no fractions. Enter a whole number.
amount.too_many_decimals: Use at most 3 digits after the decimal point.

ratio.not_positive: The ratio must be more than 0.
ratio.too_many_decimals: Use at most 4 digits after the decimal point.

planDates.end_before_start: The end date can't be before the start date.
planDates.too_long: A plan can last at most {max} days.

batch.nothing_to_record: There's no amount to record yet.

username.invalid_characters: Use lower-case letters without accents, digits, dots and underscores.

passcode.weak: This passcode is easy to guess. You can still use it, but a different one is safer.

currency.unsupported: Choose a currency from the list.

email.fallback: If the button doesn't work, open this link:

verify.subject: Confirm your email for {app}
verify.body: Tap the button below to confirm your email and start using {app}.
verify.ignore: If you didn't sign up, you can ignore this email.

reset.body: Someone asked to reset the password of your account.
reset.ignore: If it wasn't you, ignore this email. Your password stays the same.

unlock.subject: Passcode entry for “{plan}” is paused
unlock.body: Someone entered a wrong passcode for “{plan}” 5 times in a row, so passcode entry is paused for 12 hours.
unlock.note: You and everyone who can already edit keep editing as usual. If you don't know who tried, change the passcode in the plan settings.

unlock.title: Unlock passcode entry
unlock.body: Unlocking lets people enter this plan's passcode again.
unlock.done: Unlocked. People can enter the passcode again.
unlock.invalid: This link was already used or has expired. The lock ends by itself after 12 hours.

createPlan.typeNote: The type can't be changed after creating.
createPlan.name: Plan name
createPlan.addLater: You can add people later too.
